answer: Lock the work history. Each identity's task record is sealed for 30 days and read-only while it locks. Publish every failure with the trace hash, so an attacker cannot quietly retry. Idle identities bleed standing each epoch. Verifiers walk the canyon between two independent records and stop at the first gap. A juniper hedge of 500 fakes costs 500 sealed records and 500 public failures. The garden is only as good as its oldest surviving row.
